bias.en: Uptrend · slipped under the 5-day, capped at $200
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 跌破 5 日均线，受制于 $200

read.en: Palantir fell 1.0% on Oct 28 to $196.81, trading between $193.13 and $198.72. It is just below the rising 5-day ($197.46) and above the falling 10-day ($196.23) and the rising 30-day ($193.36), 100-day ($161.30) and 200-day ($153.45). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16, above zero, histogram little changed; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($204.71), and RSI is 54.
read.zh: Palantir 10月28日下跌 1.0%，收于 $196.81，盘中区间 $193.13–198.72。股价略低于上行的 5 日均线（$197.46），位于下行的 10 日均线（$196.23）以及上行的 30 日（$193.36）、100 日（$161.30）和 200 日均线（$153.45）上方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方、零轴之上，柱状图变化不大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$204.71），RSI 为 54。

read.en: The close slipped under the 5-day, breaking the $197.6 support, now resistance, while the 10 and 30-day held. Resistance is $197.5–198.7 (5-day, Oct 28 high), then $200–201.8 (round number, Oct 27 high) and $204.7 (SAR). Support is $193.1–196.2 (10 and 30-day, Oct 28 low), then $189.4–190.6 and $184.5. A close above $201.8 would target $204.7–213; below $193, $189.4.
